skill_version_boundary.only_delta: Retry route wording and one failure-routes paragraph; two lines added. Three one-call image invocations completed with the earlier snapshot; no repeat invocation.
skill_version_boundary.new_failure_paragraph: Distinguish three failure routes: `same_input` repeats the exact audited inputs in the existing run; `revised_content` creates a newly frozen child within the requester's authorized changes; `recovery_only` repairs evidence, storage or review without another image call. Explicit moderation blocks and observed transient HTTP failures use `same_input` within the existing call budget. Keep all provider safeguards and each blocked result; do not rewrite a prompt to get around a block. Missing/unknown results, save failures and recorder failures require reconciliation first. The full failure table and execution commands are in [image-runtime.md](references/image-runtime.md#failure-routes) and [photo-workflow.md](references/photo-workflow.md#retry-coordinator-and-child-binding). A same-input retry has no child lineage and needs no invented changed dimension. The lineage-v2 restriction above applies only to revised-content children.
skill_version_boundary.claim_limit: Latest workspace skill verified before freeze and again before image invocations; the later post-invocation document revision was not used to author these frozen runs.
